signal: Fiery launched JobFlow Pro, an AI-assisted workflow automation platform, and rolled out the FS700 Pro system software

email.body1:
Rob, saw Fiery launch JobFlow Pro and roll out the FS700 Pro platform.

New launches pile up more in-market accounts than any rep can follow up on by hand. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so an SDR's output scales without adding seats: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Rob, quick follow-up for Fiery.

With new products to sell, response speed and follow-up volume usually become the bottleneck before the team can ramp, and that is when good accounts go quiet. Structure matters more than most expect: tighter 75-100 word emails alone tend to lift reply rates 67%.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and our best practices that usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Rob, last bit of proof for Fiery.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other SDR teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rob, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling your team's output without adding seats is not a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SDR team? I will tailor it to Fiery either way.
